name: go_wallet_transfer
prompt:
Fix the Go wallet transfer logic.

Requirements:
- Modify transfer.go only.
- TransferMoney must reject amount <= 0.
- TransferMoney must reject self-transfer.
- TransferMoney must reject overdraft when amount > sender Balance.
- Valid transfers must decrease sender balance and increase receiver balance.
- Failed transfers must not change either wallet balance.
- Failed transfers must not write to the audit log.
- Successful transfers must be logged exactly once.
- Do not modify main.go, wallet.go, audit.go, or go.mod.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only the TransferMoney function changes.
- Use patch_plan if an import must be added to transfer.go.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: go run .
